tokens._comment: cssPrefix is optional. Left unset, any custom property the component reads but does not declare is treated as a design token. Token values are never resolved — they live in the design system — so the spec emits the token path and the consuming team maps it.

frameworksNote: Optional. Names the UI framework each platform team builds in, so each spec includes an advisory implementationHints block of framework idioms for the concepts it uses. Remove a platform to leave its spec framework-agnostic.
